source.name: Einar Forge Warrior round-005 static source
source.foundation: Einar v1 by Blender Studio / Blender Foundation
source.scope: Source-first static fighter-identity visual proof and static LOD exports; no production animation, deform-rig, or Unity integration claim.

visualReview.benchmarkPolicy: Aggregate preference metadata only; no benchmark image, crop, comparison sheet, or other benchmark pixel is published.
passedChecks: Diagnostic face, hands, feet, and grip coverage
failedChecks: Both visible hands physically enclose one hilt
Premium layered warrior costume rather than civilian workwear
Functional weapon scale, mount, grip, and contact
Combat line of action, balance, and attack intent
Neutral front, back, profile, and three-quarter modeling coverage
visualReview.singleBiggestGap: Core character authorship and identity: the delivery still reads as the licensed Einar civilian mechanic in workwear with attached props, not an unmistakable premium authored anime warrior at the God of War Ragnarok benchmark level.

mechanicalValidation.interpretation: All four static FBX imports preserve the filed object, triangle, bounds, finite-geometry, UV, and material-index claims. A factory-state follow-up reproduced the audit, report, and diagnostic render byte-for-byte. Zero FBX texture references still confirms absent texture payload rather than portability, so source-to-reimport material parity remains false.

limitations: The supplied images are Blender source/preflight renders, not game footage.
All nine source views use the same frozen combat pose; genuine neutral modeling coverage is unsupported.
The static FBXs contain no armatures, actions, modifiers, shape keys, vertex groups, or texture references.
No production deform rig, animation-ready FBX, portable baked PBR atlas, Unity integration, or runtime-performance claim is made.
Release sanitization removed checkout-specific metadata without changing the judged visual payload; the validator is now byte-idempotent, but material portability remains unsupported.

nextRound.target: Before Unity integration, submit a materially portable, fully redesigned warrior source in the same seven matched evidence categories plus genuine neutral front, back, profile, and three-quarter views and a fresh clean-FBX reimport. A new independent reviewer must prefer the candidate in at least 5 of 7 blinded comparisons, verify both hands enclose one functional hilt, find source-to-reimport material parity, pass all eight mandatory checks, and score at least 10/13 overall.
